# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Instead, report them privately using GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/JaimeOrtegaxyz/the-claude-key/security/advisories/new),
or email **jaime.ortc@gmail.com**.

Please include as much of the following as you can:

- The type of issue (e.g. injection, auth bypass, secret exposure)
- Affected version(s) and the location of the affected source
- Step-by-step instructions to reproduce
- Proof-of-concept or exploit code, if available
- The impact, including how an attacker might exploit it

## What to expect

- **Acknowledgement** within a few days.
- An assessment and, if accepted, a fix timeline.
- Credit for the report once a fix ships, unless you prefer to remain anonymous.

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| older   | :x:       |
